sections.title: Dispatch order management menu
sections.content:
![](/uploads/20987bfa555deab348b32b92.png)

**The dispatch order management menus are:**

* Dispatch orders: this menu contains every dispatch order.
* Dispatch board: this menu contains the table that shows how dispatch orders are planned for each driver, so they are easier to manage.
* Driver timesheets: this menu contains the monthly timesheet of each driver.
* Incident history: this menu contains the list of dispatch orders in the "Incident" state.

sections.title: Creating a dispatch order
sections.content:
## Ways to create a dispatch order

## Option 1: from the "Container and waybill management" menu
* Follow the instructions in **"Creating a dispatch order for a container or waybill"**.

![](/uploads/e9b242a0145d03ae0d231739.png)

## Option 2: from the details screen of a container with no dispatch order yet
![](/uploads/b38f944af54d58dd846435d2.png)

* **Step 1:** on the container details screen → click **Dispatch** → the dispatch order window opens.

* The image below shows the two task lists of the selected waybill or container:

  * Two 20ft containers can share one dispatch order.

  * You can choose which tasks to dispatch by ticking or unticking the **Select** column. The system ticks the tasks that have no vehicle yet by default.

  * Tasks that already have a dispatch order still appear in this popup; for those, the **Dispatch order** column has a value.

![](/uploads/b89b4916b07ba834d4d3970f.png)

* The **[Vehicle & Driver]** tab: fill this in when you want to create a new dispatch order for the tasks.

  * **Planned date**: the system takes it from the planned date of the selected tasks.

  * **Driver**: select the driver being assigned.

  * **Vehicle**: when you select the driver, the system fills in that driver's default vehicle. You can still choose another one.

  * **Trailer**: when you select the driver, the system fills in the default trailer for that driver's vehicle. You can still choose another one.

  * **Planned date**: the system takes it from the planned date of the selected tasks.

  * **Note for the driver:** a note for the dispatch order.

![](/uploads/02ba4cdfa9a5569ac4c7b0a3.png)

* **Step 2:** once everything is filled in, click **CREATE** or **CREATE AND SEND TO DRIVER** on the popup.

* If you choose to create the dispatch order: the system creates it and opens its screen.

* If you choose to create and send it to the driver: the system creates it, sends it to the driver, and opens its screen.

![](/uploads/509b33bbc37c5f480995879f.png)
![](/uploads/7deb68f351184484c320bc12.png)

## Option 3: from the "Dispatch orders" menu
* **Step 1:** go to a Dispatch orders menu → click **New**.

![](/uploads/767659ad12d38bb840eb80e4.png)

* **Step 2:** select the vehicle and the driver you want to assign.

![](/uploads/08e8f2ac107398cb387a6ba4.png)

* **Step 3:** select the waybill to assign.

* Select the waybill you want from the waybill list. One dispatch order can take at most two waybills, for waybills with 20ft containers. For containers of 40ft or more, only one waybill fits in one dispatch order.

![](/uploads/def1e77359f75cd876c3dbf9.png)

* **Step 4:** save the dispatch order with its assigned waybill.

![](/uploads/0e6b2d186d94dd2be29e523a.png)

* **Step 5:** the dispatch order is created. Once you save it, the system assigns the task list of the container or waybill to the order.

![](/uploads/467a80fc4255280bd3c786fb.png)

sections.title: Sending the order to the driver
sections.content:
Once the dispatch order has been created with all its details, the dispatcher reviews everything on it and gets ready to send it to the driver.

To send the order to the driver, click "**Send to driver**" on that dispatch order.

![](/uploads/61f3dbcf5a2492d6a360ab74.png)

Once confirmed, the dispatch order is sent through the mobile app to the driver assigned to it, and on the dispatcher screen the order moves to the "**Confirmed**" state.

![](/uploads/e1d32aee44db2fe885305f5a.png)

sections.title: Accepting the order for the driver
sections.content:
A dispatcher can accept (confirm) an order for the driver when the driver cannot use the app, or for an outside carrier.

To confirm the order for the driver, click "**Driver confirms**" on that dispatch order.

![](/uploads/9df01ebe44d576eeedac6c54.png)

Once confirmed, the dispatch order changes state for the driver assigned to it in the mobile app, and on the dispatcher screen the order moves to the "**Accepted by driver**" state.

![](/uploads/9778abdc9bb1d28c65648a6b.png)

sections.title: Suspending a dispatch order (vehicle incident)
sections.content:
* If the driver is working on a dispatch order — the order is "In progress" — and something happens that stops them from continuing, the driver can call the dispatcher and ask them to report an "Incident".

* The dispatcher clicks "Incident" on the dispatch order, enters the reason and confirms.

![](/uploads/f613cb2c3189965d08aca899.png)

![](/uploads/5ad113f2d364842ffd0d920c.png)

* Once the dispatch order is moved to "Incident", its state changes to "Incident".

![](/uploads/c74a17c0114f9b67f6e987fc.png)

* The dispatcher can also resume the dispatch order by clicking "Resume trip". The dispatch order then moves back to "In progress" automatically.

![](/uploads/2433a344fac31499ca0ce99e.png)

sections.title: When a dispatch order is completed
sections.content:
* A dispatch order is completed when every task in it is completed, or when no task is left that is still pending or in progress.

* Once the driver or the dispatcher completes all the tasks in the dispatch order, its state moves to "Completed".

![](/uploads/b14958f9782dcf29f2e948bb.png)

* In the dispatch order list, a completed order shows the "Completed" state in green, so the dispatcher can see the overall picture of every dispatch order at a glance.

![](/uploads/93c01aec94aa668ca407d2df.png)

sections.title: Splitting tasks out of a dispatch order
sections.content:
There are two ways to split tasks out of a dispatch order:

## Case 1: Removing tasks from a dispatch order

### Step 1

The dispatcher selects the dispatch order with the tasks to remove.

![](/uploads/4b9feb04350deed2d57a9555.png)

### Step 2

Select the tasks to remove on the "Container & Tasks" tab. Only select tasks in the "**Not started**" state.

![](/uploads/d38bd7a930e93d0e2f0a993d.png)

### Step 3

Click "Remove task" and confirm.

![](/uploads/fe67cb22a96a4d273f237e34.png)

Result: the system removes the tasks that have not started from that dispatch order. Those tasks still belong to the waybill, though, and still have to be completed.

![](/uploads/2cbb8856bba69abf09b12300.png)

## Case 2: Splitting some tasks out and assigning them to another order

### Step 1

The dispatcher selects the dispatch order with the tasks to split.

![](/uploads/4b9feb04350deed2d57a9555.png)

### Step 2

Select the tasks to split on the "Container & Tasks" tab. Only select tasks in the "**Not started**" state.

![](/uploads/d38bd7a930e93d0e2f0a993d.png)

### Step 3

Click "Split order".

![](/uploads/d221a3f0bae785d2fe25949b.png)

### Step 4

Assign an order to the tasks you selected: choose the date, the driver, and the vehicle and trailer.

![](/uploads/740e5ec28b17fc09deafdb56.png)

### Step 5

Click the create button. "Create" makes a dispatch order in the **"New"** state; "Create & Send to driver" makes the order and sends it to the driver, in the **"Awaiting confirmation"** state.

* If you click "Create": the system creates a new dispatch order, does not send it to the driver, and opens its screen.

* If you click "Create and send to driver": the system creates a new dispatch order, sends it to the driver, and opens its screen.


![](/uploads/6dff61db9d3b26225005c5c9.png)

Result: the tasks have been split out of the dispatch order. The number of linked tasks drops by the number you split out, and those tasks are assigned to the dispatch order that was just created.

![](/uploads/ca4f066c866c97fa22af9d86.png)

![](/uploads/4be9d618208419e408d66704.png)

sections.title: Adding tasks to a dispatch order
sections.content:
To add back tasks that were removed from a dispatch order, do the following:

### Step 1

The dispatcher selects the dispatch order to add the tasks to.

![](/uploads/4be9d618208419e408d66704.png)

### Step 2

Click "Add task".

![](/uploads/e9061a77ef5c5c7f1bf95d4b.png)

The system shows a popup with the tasks of the waybill, in two groups:

* Tasks already in the order, which cannot be selected
* Tasks that can be added, which can be selected and are marked in orange

![](/uploads/de4988cd95b3d518db67268f.png)

### Step 3

Select the tasks to add to the order (1) and click "Add task".

![](/uploads/28cacb57090b47636ae44e12.png)

Result: once you click the button, the selected tasks are added to the task list of that dispatch order.

![](/uploads/bb68b6371d9a49540aeb6b6d.png)

sections.title: Deleting tasks from a dispatch order or waybill
sections.content:
If the dispatcher wants to delete a task from the waybill entirely, do the following:

**Note: a deleted task is gone from the waybill completely. To get it back you have to add it again on the waybill.**

### Step 1

The dispatcher selects the dispatch order with the tasks to delete:

![](/uploads/4b9feb04350deed2d57a9555.png)

### Step 2

Select the tasks to delete.

![](/uploads/d38bd7a930e93d0e2f0a993d.png)

### Step 3

Click "Delete task", then click "OK" in the confirmation dialog.

![](/uploads/c6dca32384def6b8ce155cf4.png)

Result: the selected tasks have been deleted completely from both the order and the waybill.

![](/uploads/0db4c4c0ab6373663b90bff2.png)
